'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Nick Reisch LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Reisch]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

Typed printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
